title: Manas Tomb
short: The mausoleum of Manas — an important historical site of the epic.
howto: Accessible by car from the nearest town; check visiting rules with local authorities.

title: Koshoi Korgon
short: Koshoi fortress — an archaeological monument and viewpoint.

title: Karoool Dobo
short: Karoool hill — a place of legends with panoramic views.
howto: Short hike to the top; bring water and sturdy shoes.
